title: An inverse-image presentation with specified unit
statement: Let F:C to D be a continuous functor between small sites J and K, and let L and F_* be the constructed set-sheaf inverse and direct images [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction]. For sheaves of sets S on J and T on K, a unit presentation of T as L(S) consists of a map eta:S to F_*T, an isomorphism i:T to L(S), and the equation F_*(i) eta=eta_L(S) with the actual constructed adjunction unit.
